messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning a compact base-image rebuild to reduce attack surface (strip docs, remove pkg managers, min libc). Need to coordinate three things across teams: RBAC for cross-account pulls, KMS-based signing for images, and an audit/telemetry hook for rebuild events. Anyone available to sync? :sparkles:

sam: I can take the RBAC piece. Which registries are we targeting? GCR and our prod ECR?

maya: Yes, both. GCR for staging+canary, ECR for prod. Also a private mirror we mount in air-gapped accounts.

lin: For cross-account ECR pulls we'll want a dedicated role + external ID on the nodepool role. Suggest role name images-puller.redwood-infra. Policy pretty minimal: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken, ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability, ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer, ecr:BatchGetImage.

sam: SGTM. I'll draft the role with limited conditions (source account + VPC endpoint). Will open PR to infra-iam repo.

maya: KMS signing — prefer cosign with envelope keys. Ops: can we wrap cosign keys via KMS so we don't store raw keys on CI runners?

ops-bot: Reminder: cosign with KMS is supported. See internal runbook: https://go/repo/cosign-kms. Use KMS asymmetric keys + keyring for rotation.

tess: For the audit hook, can we push an event on successful image sign/push labeled image.rebuild.trigger + image.minified=true so we can filter in Cloud Logging/Longterm? We also need build metadata (base digest, builder-image, git ref, author).

maya: Exactly. Proposed event payload fields: image, tag, base_digest, shrink_flags, signer_kms_key, build_id, canary_release. Minimal JSON blob in stdout and a structured log line like `image.rebuild:v1`.

sam: For the canary rollout, I suggest 5% of nodes for 24h. If CPU/latency or error rate spikes, rollback automatically. We should tie a tracing span with sample: `tracing.image.rebuild` so perf dashboards can correlate.

lin: One gotcha: ECR image signing doesn't prevent pulls of unsigned images by default. We'll add an admission gate in the node bootstrap that verifies cosign attestation: `cosign verify-attestation --predicate` during init; fallback path if verification fails should fetch previous pinned digest.

maya: Can someone sketch the bootstrap snippet? short and retry-friendly.

sam: snippet:

```
# bootstrap / node init
COSIGN_KEY=projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/cosign
if ! cosign verify-attestation --key $COSIGN_KEY $IMAGE; then
  echo "attestation failed, falling back to pinned image" >&2
  IMAGE=$(cat /etc/redwood/pinned-image)
fi
```

lin: thumbs up. We'll need the pinned-image updated atomically by the rollout controller when canary passes.

maya: Audit questions: who has permission to sign? We should limit to the build account CI principal and an emergency signing role for SRE with MFA. Also log signer principal in the attestation.

tess: Agreed. Also add a short-lived delegation key for local dev that requires a ticket. Keep wide signing disabled.

ops-bot: Action created: #IAM-1723 create images-puller role and add condition for infra nodepool. Assigned to sam.

sam: I'll open infra-iam PR and a matching PR in infra-nodepool to reference the role. Will also add automated tests in staging to verify cross-account pull.

maya: I'll draft the cosign KMS runbook + required attestation schema and telemetry fields. Posting in #eng-runtime once ready.

lin: One more: vuln triage — removing package managers might break some image scanners that rely on package DBs. We should add a SBOM step and ensure scanners ingest SBOMs instead of OS package heuristics.

maya: Good call. Add sbom:syft JSON artifact attached to the build event.

tess: Okay — I'll add alert rules: if image.rebuild triggered and sbom missing => page infra-builds.

maya: Thanks all — let's meetup 30m after lunch to walk the PRs and roll plan. :calendar:
